# Copilot instructions for this repository

Copilot reads this file automatically and adds it as context to every chat in this repo.
Demo point: this is how a client standardizes AI output across hundreds of developers.

- Use TypeScript with strict typing. No `any`.
- Never hardcode secrets, passwords, connection strings or API keys. Read them from environment variables.
- Every new function needs a unit test.
- Follow the existing folder structure and naming.
- Prefer small, focused functions with clear names.
- Flag any code that handles personal or health data so a human reviews it.
